item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a simple periscope with two plane mirrors. Rhea stands so the object is not directly visible to her eye. Light from the object reaches her eye after meeting both mirrors.

Which claim correctly explains how she sees the object?

options.A: Each plane mirror reflects the light so the ray path turns and reaches her eye around the barrier.
options.B: The mirrors bend the light by refraction through glass, not by reflection.
options.C: Only the lower mirror works; the upper mirror is decorative and unused.
options.D: She sees the object because the periscope tube itself glows and sends light to her eye.
